title: 第666章 少宗主第665章 修为再涨
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
第666章：少宗主
即便是季沧海等金丹长老，也在这股元婴级别的威压之下被压得双膝发软，不由自主地跪了下去。
但他们并没有觉得屈辱，恰恰相反，
每一个跪下的人脸上都写满了难以抑制的惊喜和激动。
因为这股威压意味着掌门的元婴已经初成，天劫已经平安渡过，
苍玄宗从此有了一位货真价实的元婴大能坐镇。
这意味着什么？
意味着苍玄宗从此在南华边区再也不用看任何人的脸色了。
“恭贺掌门突破元婴！”
“恭贺掌门突破元婴！”
一时间，整个苍玄宗上下一心，齐声高呼。
弟子们的欢呼声从山脚响到山顶，
从外门响到内门，声浪一浪高过一浪，汇聚成一股震撼人心的洪流，
在群峰之间久久回荡。
可以说，何元岳突破元婴，对苍玄宗而言意义重大到了极点。
不单是多了一位顶级战力那么简单，整个南华边区的势力格局都要因此重新洗牌。
那些之前对苍玄宗虎视眈眈的势力，从今往后都得掂量掂量自己有没有招惹元婴修士的资本。
等到那道巨大的虚影缓缓收敛，重新没入何元岳体内之后，
何元岳缓缓睁开了眼睛。
他低头看了看自己的双手，感受着体内那股远超金丹境的磅礴力量，

然后抬起头来，用一种惊喜到近乎失态的目光望着林枫，
“枫儿，突破了，为师终于突破元婴了！
为师以为这辈子都不可能迈过这道坎，没想到……没想到真的做到了！”
林枫笑着点头，“恭喜师父，现在您也是元婴大佬了。
从今往后，苍玄宗有您坐镇，看谁还敢来欺负咱们。”
何元岳惊喜不已地站起身来，走到林枫面前，用力地拍了拍他的肩膀。
他的声音里满是发自肺腑的感激和如释重负的畅快：
“都是托你的福，托你的福啊。
要是没有你送的那枚破婴丹，为师连冲击元婴的资格都没有；
要是没有你替为师扛住天劫，为师早就被那三道天雷劈成焦炭了。
这辈子能收你这个徒弟，真是为师天大的运气，是苍玄宗列祖列宗积了八辈子的德。”
林枫笑了笑，忽然想起了一件事，好奇地问道：
“师父，方才天劫降临的时候，你可曾看到一朵莲花？”
他有些好奇，黑莲的存在何元岳能不能看到？
就在他正下方打坐，距离那么近，说不定能看到些什么。
他也拿不准何元岳到底能不能看见黑莲的虚影。
何元岳摇了摇头，脸上露出一丝茫然的神色，仔细回忆了一下才回答道：
“什么莲花？为师就看到你一个人站在虚空中抵抗雷劫，
天雷劈到你身上之后就莫名其妙地消失了，
连一丝痕迹都没有留下。

你整个人纹丝未动，连衣服都没皱一下，
为师在下面看得清清楚楚。不愧是传说中的雷灵根，
连天雷都能轻易化解，当真是厉害得让人不敢相信。”
content_en:
Chapter 666: Young Sect Master
Even Ji Canghai and other Jindan elders were so suppressed by this Nascent Soul-level pressure that their knees became weak and they knelt down involuntarily.
But they didn't feel humiliated, on the contrary,
The faces of everyone who knelt down were filled with uncontrollable surprise and excitement.
Because this coercion means that the leader’s Nascent Soul has already begun to take shape and the natural disaster has been safely passed.
Cangxuan Sect now has a genuine Nascent Soul power in charge.
what does that mean?
This means that Cangxuan Sect no longer has to look at anyone's face in the Nanhua Border Region.
"Congratulations to the leader for breaking through to Nascent Soul!"
"Congratulations to the leader for breaking through to Nascent Soul!"
For a time, the entire Cangxuan Sect was united and shouted in unison.
The cheers of the disciples rang from the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain,
From the outer door to the inner door, the sound waves got louder and louder, converging into a shocking torrent.
Echoing among the peaks for a long time.
It can be said that He Yuanyue's breakthrough to Yuanying is extremely significant to Cangxuan Sect.
Not only is it as simple as adding a top combat force, but the power structure of the entire South China Border Region will be reshuffled as a result.
Those forces that had previously been eyeing Cangxuan Sect would have to consider whether they have the capital to provoke the Yuanying monks from now on.
After the huge shadow slowly converged and submerged into He Yuanyue's body again,
He Yuanyue slowly opened his eyes.
He looked down at his hands and felt the majestic power in his body that far exceeded the golden elixir realm.
Then he raised his head and looked at Lin Feng with a look that was so surprised that he almost lost his temper.
"Feng'er, we have a breakthrough, my master has finally broken through to the Nascent Soul!
I thought I would never be able to overcome this hurdle in my life, but I didn’t expect... I didn’t expect that I actually did it! "
Lin Feng smiled and nodded, "Congratulations, Master, now you are also the boss of Yuanying.
From now on, Cangxuan Sect has you in charge, let’s see who dares to bully us. "
He Yuanyue stood up in surprise, walked up to Lin Feng, and patted his shoulder hard.
His voice was full of heartfelt gratitude and relief:
“It’s all thanks to you, thanks to you.
Without the Broken Infant Pill you gave me, I would not even be qualified to attack the Nascent Soul;
If it weren't for you to withstand the catastrophe for me, I would have been chopped into charcoal by those three thunders.
It is my great luck to have you as my disciple in this life. It is the virtue accumulated by the ancestors of Cangxuan Sect for eight lifetimes. "
Lin Feng smiled, suddenly remembered something, and asked curiously:
"Master, when the catastrophe just came, did you see a lotus flower?"
He was a little curious, could He Yuanyue see the existence of Black Lotus?
Just meditate right below him, so close, maybe you can see something.
He was also not sure whether He Yuanyue could see the shadow of Hei Lian.
He Yuanyue shook his head, with a confused look on his face. He recalled carefully before replying:
"What lotus? I saw you standing alone in the void resisting the thunder calamity.
After the thunder struck you, you disappeared inexplicably.
Not even a trace was left.
You didn't move at all, not even a wrinkle in your clothes.
The teacher can see clearly from below. It is indeed the legendary Lei Linggen.
Even the thunder can be easily defused, it is so powerful that people cannot believe it. "
